english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something physically shaking with rapid small movements.

exampleSentences.english: I can feel my phone vibrate under the pillow.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我隔住個枕頭都感覺到部手機震。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gaak3 zyu6 go3 zam2 tau4 dou1 gam2 gok3 dou3 bou6 sau2 gei1 zan3

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a hand, limb, object, or other thing moving with a slight tremor.

exampleSentences.english: I felt my hand quiver and couldn't hold the glass steady.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 sau2 zan3 ling1 m4 wan2 bui1 seoi2

english.note: Use this mainly when an object or surface is shaking or vibrating, rather than a person visibly quivering.

exampleSentences.english: The shaking table makes me tremble, so don't move it.
exampleSentences.jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 zan3 gan2 m4 hou2 juk1 zyu6

english.note: Use 震 for a vehicle or object that jolts along a rough surface rather than hitting another object.

exampleSentences.english: The car continued to bump along the rough road.
exampleSentences.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 hai2 laan6 lou6 dou6 jat1 lou6 zan3

english.note: Use this for a physical object vibrating or making a sound in response to another sound or vibration.

exampleSentences.english: The table starts to resonate when the tuning fork rings.
exampleSentences.jyutping: jam1 caa1 jat1 hoeng2 zoeng1 ci4 dou1 zan3 maai4
